text: The path components π₀(X) of a simplicial set X are:
choices: The set X₀ modulo the equivalence relation generated by 1-simplices (d₁σ ~ d₀σ for σ∈X₁)
The homotopy classes of maps from Δ[1] to X
The set of connected components of |X|
explanation: π₀(X): X₀/~ where a~b iff there exists σ:Δ[1]→X with d₀σ=a, d₁σ=b.
